steps.name: Blend the sunset sky
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. It reaches all four edges of the canvas.

steps.name: Dry-brush the gold cloud streaks
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across from the top edge. Its bottom is about 2 1/2 in from the top edge.

steps.name: Light the tops of the clouds
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is at the top edge, and its left side is at the left edge; it's about 10 in wide and 2 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Lay in the far violet hills
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across. Its top is about 2 1/2 in from the top edge and its bottom is about 5 in from the top edge.

steps.name: Shade the near hills
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 2 1/2 in from the top edge, and its right side is about 1/2 in from the right edge; it's about 1/2 in wide and 1 3/4 in tall.

steps.name: Lay in the sliver of loch
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 4 1/2 in from the top edge, and its right side is at the right edge; it's about 2 in wide and 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Lay in the green hillside
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across to the bottom edge. Its top is about 3 1/2 in from the top edge.

steps.name: Streak the dark patches on the hillside
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across to the bottom edge. Its top is about 3 in from the top edge.

steps.name: Lay in the meadow
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across to the bottom edge. Its top is about 7 in from the top edge.

steps.name: Block in the cow
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is about 3 in from the bottom edge, and its left side is about 1 1/4 in from the left edge; it's about 7 1/2 in wide and 8 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Shade the cow's dark side
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is about 3 in from the bottom edge, and its left side is about 1 1/2 in from the left edge; it's about 5 in wide and 8 in tall.

steps.name: Block in the horns
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 3 in from the top edge, and its right side is about 2 1/2 in from the right edge; it's about 6 in wide and 2 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Shade the horns and darken the tips
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 3 in from the top edge, and its right side is about 2 1/2 in from the right edge; it's about 6 in wide and 2 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Pull the ginger locks
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is about 3 1/2 in from the bottom edge, and its left side is about 1 1/2 in from the left edge; it's about 4 1/2 in wide and 7 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Pull the golden tan locks
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is about 3 1/2 in from the bottom edge, and its left side is about 1 3/4 in from the left edge; it's about 4 1/2 in wide and 7 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Paint the nose
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 7 1/2 in from the top edge, and its right side is about 4 in from the right edge; it's about 1 in wide and 1 in tall.

steps.name: Dot the nostrils and line the mouth
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 7 1/2 in from the top edge, and its right side is about 4 in from the right edge; it's about 1 in wide and 3/4 in tall.

steps.name: Flick the dark grass blades
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across to the bottom edge. Its top is about 5 1/2 in from the bottom edge.

steps.name: Flick the sunlit grass
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is at the bottom edge, and its right side is about 1/4 in from the right edge; it's about 11 1/2 in wide and 6 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Flick the gold seed heads
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is about 1 3/4 in from the bottom edge, and its right side is about 1/4 in from the right edge; it's about 11 1/2 in wide and 4 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Light the gold rim on the cow
steps.where: Inside the outlined area. Its bottom is about 3 in from the bottom edge, and its left side is about 3 in from the left edge; it's about 6 in wide and 8 1/2 in tall.

steps.name: Dry-brush the brightest lights
steps.where: Inside the outlined area, all the way across. Its top is about 8 in from the bottom edge and its bottom is about 1 3/4 in from the bottom edge.
